records.name: earendil-works/pi
records.qualification: Selective source and test inspection only. No build or test execution.

inspected.observation: Version 1.4.0. Node >=22.19.0. Agent core depends on pi-ai and TypeBox.
Version 1.4.0. Provider SDK and protocol dependencies are distinct from coding-agent CLI.
Agent options support injected stream function, auth, context transforms, hooks, subscriptions, abort and waitForIdle. State is in memory.
Arguments validated before mutable beforeToolCall hook and not revalidated by this path afterward.
Contains truncated-tool-call suppression, deliberate mutated-hook-without-revalidation behavior and execution ordering cases.
Streaming API uses model.baseUrl. OpenAI-compatible routing alone defaults supportsStrictMode false.
Strict JSON Schema conversion has prefer or require behavior. Unsupported required constraints reject before generation.
Tests unsupported schemas and capability fallback rather than assuming strict output everywhere.
Cross-model preparation drops incompatible thought/signature artifacts, normalizes tool IDs and emits error results for missing tool outcomes.
Live handoff test has auth and insufficient-fixture skips. No live result measured in this audit.
createAgentSession is an embedding API with noTools and tool selection. Broad coding-agent defaults require deliberate removal.
Inspected rewrite truncates directly and append uses file append. This path is transcript persistence rather than an artifact transaction journal.
Separate pi-durable package offers storage-backed task and harness surfaces.
Exports Task, Session, Harness, model providers and multiple storage adapters.

Final hook arguments are revalidated, exact JSON intent recorded, unsafe replay denied, safe replay requires both historical and current tool policy. Result and task settlement share a storage commit.
Batch changes and sequence update execute in one SQLite transaction. In-memory adoption follows successful commit.
Partial generation snapshots are persisted on an interval. Terminal classification, continuation and retry remain separate decisions.
Tests unsafe interruption, two-sided replay policy, changed-cwd replay for safe tools, nested memo decisions and invalid strict JSON output.
MemoryStorage failure scheduling tests cancellation marks and barriers. Not hard-process-kill evidence.
Cyclic JSON error rolls back entry, task and sequence within SQLite commit test.
Separate pi-mcp transports support stdio and Streamable HTTP with reconnect and bounded transient retry.

Root engineering guidance inspected fully. Requires full-file reading for audits, exact dependency pins, explicit install-script review and focused tests that do not accidentally enable paid endpoint tests. It does not promise backward compatibility by default.
Core is deliberately minimal and extension-first. New contributors face a maintainer approval gate. Changes that expand core or hook complexity require discussion.

records.finding: Best initial library candidate when native host owns workspace, policy, events and effect receipts. pi-durable has materially stronger recovery than coding-agent transcript persistence.
records.reuse: Embed pi-ai plus pi-agent-core behind a bundled worker. Evaluate pi-durable in S01 without introducing a second authoritative task database. Borrow replay and cancellation test shapes.
records.limits: No installation, packaging, provider calls or tests executed. Local endpoint conformance, Windows process termination, disk durability and dual-process fencing remain experiments. Changed cwd replay is tested upstream and must be constrained by the host.

records.name: anomalyco/opencode
records.qualification: Selective source and test inspection only. No build or test execution.

inspected.observation: Version 2.1.4, embedded SDK package.
Exports OpenCode, Tool and typed client events and contracts.
OpenCode entry delegates to Promise SDK create.
Creates ManagedRuntime and in-process route handler. Default database path is :memory:. Starts suspended-session recovery automatically.
Node, Bun and workerd conditional adapters and native PTY, SQLite, filesystem and parser dependencies.
Uses TestLLM injection and embedded session routes including switchModel and prompt. No CLI spawning required for this surface.
Generic configurable baseURL and optional bearer credentials route.
Fixture tests cover request shape, sparse parallel tool chunks and rejection of missing required finish reason.
Input decoded before execution. Raw JSON Schema conversion failure returns input unchanged. Raw JSON output schema path checks JSON serializability rather than schema semantics.
Before hook runs before input decoding. After hook can alter result after output validation.
Tool call publication precedes local execution. Tools start during stream and final settlement is protected against interruption.
Explicit at-least-once recovery, durable resume counter and assumption prior claim owner is dead. Background shell jobs marked cancelled during restart.
Process-local keyed serialization. Interrupt accepts request before cleanup completes. awaitIdle waits settlement.
Durable claim, release, countResume and ordered event persistence contracts.
Tests single local admission, exhausted resume budget and durable counting before resumed work.
Local stdio through Environment, Streamable HTTP, lifecycle cleanup and explicit remote session termination attempt.

Root engineering guidance inspected fully. The default branch is dev. Session execution claims are process-local restart markers, not clustered ownership, fencing or exactly-once guarantees. Durable prompt admission precedes execution. SDK composes Client, Core and Server.
Development requires Bun 1.3 or newer. UI/core product features require design review. Tests run from package directories and public protocol changes require regenerated clients.
AI transport performs one model call and is independent of Session. Auth, permission, plugin and orchestration policy belong in Core. Provider cassette replay is the default test mode.

Tool catalog filtering is not execution authorization. Leaves own permission checks and effect ordering. Registrations and captured executors are Location-scoped, and tool reload does not itself revoke an already captured executor.

records.finding: Current source supports real in-process embedding. It is a coherent alternative, not merely a CLI wrapper. More lifecycle infrastructure comes with greater coupling and native packaging surface.
records.reuse: Keep an Electron/TypeScript embedded-SDK alternative with explicit persistent database and Rust workspace authority. Reuse host-side schemas and effect controls even if choosing this SDK.
records.limits: No runtime executed. Embedded host must enforce exclusive recovery ownership. At-least-once resumption is not external-effect exactly-once. Raw schema fallback and post-hook mutation require host validation.

records.qualification: Selective source and test inspection only. No build or test execution.

inspected.observation: Version 1.58.1, Python >=3.12, LiteLLM and FastMCP dependency ranges.
TypeScript client also present with OpenRouter SDK dependency.
A local TypeScript agent loop exists. persistenceDir is declared and assigned, with no usage beyond those locations in this inspected file.
CancellationToken uses threading.Event. Tool cooperation is required.
Persist callback precedes subscribers. switch_llm preserves registry metrics. interrupt cancels active async task and signals tools. Sync fallback pauses at boundary.
Per-event JSON store, locking, event ID indexing and count-marker recovery. Local locking assumptions are explicit.
Text writes call atomic helper. Cache assumes exclusive file access. Local file lock has timeout.
Temporary file, flush, fsync and os.replace for atomic text replacement. Directory fsync is not present in inspected helper.
Tests missing/corrupt data and thread concurrency. Corrupt JSON can be omitted from rebuilt index. Two-instance test is serial interleaving, not concurrent processes.
Mock slow async LLM interrupted, cancelled token retained for outliving tool threads, not-started tools skipped.
Custom base URL, Ollama URL, streaming callbacks and retry/timeout controls. Default drop_params true.
Provider parsing includes localhost OpenAI-compatible case. Does not connect to local inference.
Normalizes and repairs tool arguments, constructs validated actions and emits structured error events.
Mock invalid arguments produce error and omit large raw argument value from test message.
Typed stdio, HTTP, Streamable HTTP and SSE config with secret fields and transport-specific validation.

Root engineering guidance inspected fully. Python SDK and Agent Server own canonical behavior. Resource ownership, cancellation, persisted settings migrations, secret serialization and packaged-runtime parity are explicit engineering boundaries.

SDK is a reusable foundation rather than a client-specific application. Workspace assumptions must remain explicit and confined to workspace implementations. Long-tail provider behavior should use generic interfaces.

Supports Python 3.12 and later while repository tooling targets 3.13. Public removals require at least five minor releases of deprecation. Deprecated event-field loading handlers are permanent, and persisted settings changes require schema migrations and golden fixtures.

Browser-compatible client forbids Node filesystem/process APIs. It documents LocalWorkspace as a stub despite a LocalConversation loop and an example constructing LocalWorkspace. The guide says package.json config.agentServerImage is authoritative, but its prose examples still name 1.51.0 while the inspected manifest pins 1.58.1.

Review guidance requires tracing create/run/interrupt/close/resume/fork, underlying task and process settlement, production packaging, and exact pinned consumer/server versions. ACP tool visibility alone is not proof of execution restriction.

records.finding: Credible Python SDK alternative for tool ecosystems, with local persistence and interruption surfaces. Packaging a Python stack beside Rust/React is a higher initial burden for this product.
records.reuse: Retain as measured alternative if Python tool integration clearly wins. Do not assume its TypeScript local loop has persistence parity with Python.
records.limits: Tests not run. No hard kill, server sandbox, cross-provider quality or remote durability measured. Tool thread cancellation is cooperative. Local EventLog is not the product transaction authority.
